candidate_reports.remark: Delayed report. Public report to NWS Little Rock social media and then relayed to our office. Time estimated from radar.
Reports of trees down in residential areas in Kingston_ including some on houses. Time estimated by radar.
Report of either a power pole or power line downed due to wind on G Street NW in Miami. Time estimated from radar.
Strong thunderstorm wind uprooted several trees_ snapped large tree limbs_ and damaged the roofs of a couple homes.
Delayed report. Video of hail with a max size of a quarter. Time of event listed as the time of the video which also fits well with radar data.
Corrects time of previous hail report from Coweta. Delayed report. Video of hail with a max size of a quarter. Time of event listed as the time of the video which also fits well with radar data.
Mostly pea to marble sized hail with some quarter size. Hail lasted for approximately 30 minutes covering ground. Extensive crop damage from wind driven hail.
Report from mPING: Quarter (1.00 in.). Time adjusted from original report through radar.
Trees uprooted_ large_ 8 to 10 inch diameter branches broken. CR 546 impassable with fallen trees and limbs. Estimated 70 to 80 mph winds reported at local nursery. Extensive crop damage due to wind
Large trees down. Report relayed via emergency management. Time is radar estimated.
Photos of tree and building damage in Marble relayed by broadcast media. Time estimated by radar.
Tree downed. Time estimated by radar.
Roof damage to house. Time estimated from radar.
3 inch tree limbs snapped. 5 inch diameter tree down. Spotter network report. Tree damage observed near east 82nd and east 81st streets. Time revised from the initial report using radar information.
Public report of trees and tree limbs down around the Stilwell area posted to broadcast media social media. Time estimated by radar.
Reports of trees down_ fence damage and some structural damage in the vicinity of Diffee Drive and Balentine Road. Time estimated by radar.
From Oklahoma Forestry...numerous large trees down_ communications tower blown over_ some structure damage at OFS Tahelquah office. Time estimated from Radar.
Power pole snapped with the gust front winds. Tiime estimated from radar. Report initially from law enforcement_ relayed via amateur radio operator.
Tree snapped at the base with a large limb down. Time revised from the initial report using radar information.
Trees down and power outages. Public posts to Crawford County emergency management social media. Time estimated by radar.
Trees and power lines down. Public posts to Crawford County emergency management social media. Time estimated by radar.
8 moderate size limbs downed. Public post on Crawford County emergency management social media. Time estimated by radar.
Trees and powerlines down. Roof off a shed. Public posts to Crawford County emergency management social media. Time estimated by radar.
Report of power out and trees down in Natural Dam from the public on the Crawford County emergency management social media. Time estimated from radar.
Trees blown down from outflow gust front_ time estimated from radar.
trees blown down front gust front passage_ time estimated from radar.
Tree fell onto a home on Hazel Street. Public post on Crawford County emergency management social media. Time estimated by radar.
trees downed from gust front along Hwy 10_ time estimated from radar.
Multiple public reports of trees down on Rackley Mountain Road near the Chester Cutoff posted to Crawford County emergency management social media. Time estimated by radar.
Tree damage in Mulberry per OGE. Time estimated by radar.
Public reports of trees down and power outages in Chester posted to Crawford County Emergency Management social media. Time estimated by radar.
Large limbs and trees down. Damage to a home. Off Hickory Trail in Mountainburg. Public report posted to Crawford County emergency management social media. Time estimated from radar.
Downed power lines in trees on North 31st Street in Ozark. Relayed by Franklin Co. Emergency Management. Time estimated by radar.
Tree damage. Public post to broadcast media social media. Time estimated by radar.
Power poles and trees down. Roof damage at the high school. Public post on Crawford County emergency management social media. Time estimated from radar.
Multiple reports of tree damage in Ozark. North 26th Street_ North 29th_ 800 block of West Gibson. Some trees on houses. Time estimated from radar.
Trees down near the community of Graphic. Public report posted to broadcast media social media. Time estimated by radar.
Significant damage to a large tree in Alix. Time estimated from radar.
Public report of lots of tree damage and the power out posted to broadcast media social media. Time estimated by radar.
The Stuart Oklahoma Mesonet station measured a wind gusts of 57 mph.
Delayed report seen on social media. Time is from a time stamped radar image included on the social media post.
Strong thunderstorm wind snapped large tree limbs and damaged fences.
Report from mPING: Half-inch (0.50 in.).
Roof damage to manufactured home and travel trailer tipped over.
Multiple trees down and a roof taken off of a shed; Time estimated by radar.
Golf ball size hail reported 3 west of LeFlore_ OK.
